properties.description:
This algorithm identifies beaconing patterns from network traffic connection logs based on recurrent time delta patterns.
Any network connection towards the untrusted public networks at repetitive time delta is an indication of malware callbacks or data exfiltration attempts. 
The anomaly will calculate time delta between consecutive network connection between same source and destination ip as well as count (Connections in time-delta sequence) of 
time-delta sequence between same source and destination. Percentage of beaconing is calculated between connections in time-delta sequence against total connections in a day.
properties.displayName: Detect machine generated network beaconing behavior
